svg.title: GitHub activity — 948 contributions shown in the last year
svg.desc: Snapshot for anhnam26. 6 public repositories, 9 stars on owned non-fork repositories. Calendar 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-13. Updated 13 Oct 2026 (UTC+7). Red and blue teams play three one-minute matches beneath the calendar, with a central scoreboard and fixed 3–2 results.

svg.title: Pixel Sports Club - red versus blue
svg.desc: Four distinct pixel cartoon athletes in a seamless 180-second loop: football, basketball and volleyball, 60 seconds each. Blue wins football 3-2, red wins basketball 3-2, blue wins volleyball 3-2. Scores change at 18, 28, 38, 48 and 56 seconds. Red steals and scores in the third basketball play. The ball rises, spins, glows and morphs as each court transforms. Football and basketball restart with the conceding team; the volleyball point winner serves behind the end line.
